_comment: The single checked-in list the API and the portal both assert against, so a code added to one side without the other fails a test. Lives beside katastr-document.ts and import-plan.ts, where these codes are actually defined — the API is the producer, the portal only renders. The API's own katastr-error-codes.spec.ts ties this file to KatastrParseErrorCode / ImportBlockerCode / ImportWarningCode at compile time (a Record<Code, true> literal that TypeScript rejects if it is missing a union member or carries one that does not exist) and then compares its keys to this file at runtime. The portal cannot import those TS unions — apps/portal and apps/api are separate deployable apps — so apps/portal/src/features/admin/components/katastr-import/messages.test.ts reads this same file via a relative fs path and compares it to KATASTR_ERROR_CODES / KATASTR_BLOCKER_CODES / KATASTR_WARNING_CODES.
